title: Contains Duplicate
description: Given an integer array nums, return true if any value appears at least twice in the array, and return false if every element is distinct.

title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to target. You may assume each input has exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise. An anagram uses exactly the same characters with the same counts.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of integers nums and an integer target, return the index of target if it exists, otherwise return -1. Your solution should run in O(log n) time.

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray containing at least one number which has the largest sum, and return that sum.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string s containing only the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', return true if every bracket is closed by the matching type and in the correct order.

title: Group Anagrams
description: Given an array of strings strs, group the anagrams together. Return the groups in any order, but sort the strings inside each group alphabetically so the result is deterministic.

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array nums, return an array where each element is the product of every other element in nums. Solve it without using division and in O(n) time.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given an array of intervals where intervals[i] = [start, end], merge all overlapping intervals and return the non-overlapping intervals that cover every input interval. Return them sorted by start.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated characters.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given n non-negative integers height representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted arrays nums1 and nums2, return the median of the two arrays combined. The overall run time should be O(log (m + n)).
